reviewed_upstream.observation: QymCAD construction is a thin Rust wrapper over a native C ABI that takes flat f64 profile arrays and offset tables.
The file only names primitive faces by role; it contains no construction algorithm.
The file only names profile walls/caps; construction stays in the native bridge.

rationale: The construction adapter is new code against the pinned OCCT 8.0.1 C++ API. QymCAD's shape/build.rs is a thin C ABI wrapper and its face naming (Roles/GeoName) belongs to a different history/naming design, so no code is copied or reused. Only the ABI shape (flat f64 arrays plus offset tables) is aligned conceptually.
not_reused: QymCAD Roles/GeoName naming: our publication names are per-snapshot UUIDs, not role keys.
QymCAD native C ABI: the adapters are our own in crates/om9-kernel/src/creation_bridge.cpp.
l3_scope: sphere, cylinder, box, cone, torus BRep shapes
